title: HPA Cell Atlas Standard Immunostaining Protocol
author: Peter Thul
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x2dfqa6
materials: Add 40 µL blocking buffer with diluted primary antibodies; 2 ug/ml HPA antibody, 1 ug/ml anti-alpha tubulin (Abcam, Ab7291), and 1.25 ug/ml anti-calreticulin (Abcam, Ab2908). Incubate over night at 4°C or for two hours at room temperature. 4 °C 16:00:00, overnight or 20 °C, (RT) 02:00:00
Remove the blocking buffer with primary antibodies and wash the cells with 40 µL 1X PBS for 4 x 10 minutes. 00:10:00 00:10:00 00:10:00 00:10:00

Add 40 µL blocking buffer with diluted secondary antibodies; 2.5 ug/ml anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, A11034), 2.5 ug/ml anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 555 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, A21424), and 2.5 ug/ml anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (Thermo Fisher Scientific, A21449). Incubate at room temperature for 90 minutes while keeping dark. 01:30:00

steps.title: Aspirate growth medium
steps.instruction: Aspirate approximately 80 µL of growth medium from each well.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL of 1X PBS to each well and wash the cells once.

steps.title: Fix cells with PFA
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL of 4 % paraformaldehyde in 1X PBS to each well and incubate for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Remove the PFA solution, then add 40 µL of 0.1 % Triton X‑100 in 1X PBS and incubate for three cycles of 5 minutes each.

steps.title: Wash after permeabilization
steps.instruction: Remove the Triton X‑100 solution and wash the cells once with 40 µL of 1X PBS.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with DAPI
steps.instruction: Remove the blocking buffer, then add 40 µL of 0.2 µg/mL DAPI in 1X PBS and incubate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash post‑DAPI
steps.instruction: Wash the cells with 40 µL of 1X PBS for four washes of 10 minutes each.

steps.title: Mount and seal plate
steps.instruction: Fill the wells with glycerol/10X PBS, seal the plate with an adhesive aluminium PCR plate seal, and store at 4 °C for at least two weeks.
